kamloops.title: 2026 BC Summer Games open in Kelowna under smoke warning
kamloops.description: Despite an air quality warning, organizers decided the Games could continue safely on Friday morning, after consulting with Environment Canada and closely monitoring conditions

all.description: 'Part of the backbone of the grid is near where there's a lot of fire activity in the Southern Interior,' Bob Gammer, BC Hydro community relations coordinator, told CKPG News.

all.title: ‘I’m not leaving’: Some B.C. residents vow to defend homes from wildfires
all.description: As wildfires intensify across Canada, a transportation expert says governments need a national firefighting strategy focused on prevention instead of evacuation.

all.title: Photos show wildfires raging across parts of British Columbia
all.description: Hundreds are out of their homes and thousands are on evacuation alert across the province, as wildfire crews battle the flames from the ground and the air.
